mentions.name: Lockstep Arcade
mentions.description: A collection of networked multiplayer games built around a lockstep deterministic network model with 'delay frames' between acting directly on user input and progressing the shared network state. Each included game takes a different approach to solving the network delay problem of providing immediate feedback to user input while hiding that actual changes to shared state are delayed.
mentions.problem: The network delay problem in multiplayer games: providing immediate feedback to user input while hiding the fact that actual changes to shared network state are delayed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a collection of networked games, around the central theme of a lockstep deterministic network model with 'delay frames' (between acting directly on user input and progressing actual shared network state).

You can try this here: https://locksteparcade.com/Client
